scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.db:migrate: turbo run build --filter=@timemachine/storage... && node --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/database.mjs migrate
scripts.db:prune: turbo run build --filter=@timemachine/storage... && node --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/database.mjs prune
scripts.start:dashboard: turbo run build --filter=@timemachine/dashboard... && node --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/dashboard.mjs start
scripts.dev:dashboard: turbo run build --filter=@timemachine/core && node --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/dashboard.mjs dev
scripts.replay:register: turbo run build --filter=@timemachine/replay... && node packages/replay/dist/cli.js register
scripts.replay:check: turbo run build --filter=@timemachine/replay... && node packages/replay/dist/cli.js check
scripts.record: turbo run build --filter=@timemachine/sdk-node... && node --env-file-if-exists=.env packages/sdk-node/dist/record-cli.js record
